description_en: Create a bucket for collaborative storage
description_zh: 创建协同存储的Bucket存储空间
name: PutBucket

parameters.help_en: Bucket name. Must be 3 to 50 characters long. Use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (-). Cannot start or end with a hyphen
parameters.help_zh:
Bucket名称。
3~50 个字符，只允许小写字母、数字、短横线（-），且不能以短横线开头或结尾
parameters.name: bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The logical type of the bucket. Valid values: sink: A sink bucket on a specified node. standard: A standard global bucket. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
逻辑bucket类型，取值范围：
sink: 下沉（指定节点）
standard：标准(全局)（默认值）
parameters.name: logical_bucket_type

parameters.help_en: Comment. Up to 128 characters, including letters, digits, Chinese characters, and emojis
parameters.help_zh: 备注。长度为0-128个字符、汉字或表情符等
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: Bucket permission type: private (default). public-read-write: Allows public read and write access. public-read: Allows public read access
parameters.help_zh:
Bucket权限类型：
private：私有（默认值）
public-read-write：公共读写
public-read：公共读
parameters.name: bucket_acl

parameters.help_en: Edge zone ID. If not specified, the global default edge zone is used
parameters.help_zh: 节点区域id，不指定时为全局默认节点
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Scheduling scope. Valid values:

domestic (within China)

outside China

You must specify this parameter when creating a global bucket
parameters.help_zh:
调度范围，取值范围：
domestic（国内）
oversea（海外）

当创建全局bucket时该参数必须指定
parameters.name: dispatch_scope
